description: This Java class defines a BreadcrumbItem entity used in a web shopping context to represent individual breadcrumb navigation items, including properties such as id, label, URL, and item type.

classes.name: BreadcrumbItem
classes.description: A serializable Java class representing a breadcrumb navigation item with properties for id, label, URL, and item type.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the id of the breadcrumb item.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the id of the breadcrumb item.

methods.name: getLabel
methods.description: Returns the label of the breadcrumb item.

methods.name: setLabel
methods.description: Sets the label of the breadcrumb item.

methods.name: getUrl
methods.description: Returns the URL of the breadcrumb item.

methods.name: setUrl
methods.description: Sets the URL of the breadcrumb item.

methods.name: getItemType

methods.description: Sets the item type of the breadcrumb item.
